description:
Why do beginner gardens fail even with good soil?

I build a small garden and find the one thing my plants were missing.

What would you have checked first? Tell me in the comments.

Like and share this with someone starting their first garden.
ig_caption: It wasn't the soil. What would you have checked first? #gardening #plants
